logs.title: Application logs
logs.description: View the latest slice of the application's runtime log for troubleshooting.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Manage the app theme, interface zoom, and display language.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Choose a light, dark, or system-matching color scheme.
theme.label: App theme
theme.hint: Dark mode (Ayu Mirage) is tuned for code-dense sessions.

zoom.title: Interface zoom
zoom.description: Scale the whole interface for your display and eyesight. Applies instantly and is remembered.
zoom.label: Zoom level
zoom.hint: Affects the display size of the entire app interface.

language.title: Language
language.description: Choose the interface display language. Applies instantly and is remembered.
language.label: Interface language
language.hint: Bilingual coverage is progressive — some screens are still Chinese-only and will be completed over time.

shortcuts.sendModifierEnterHelper: Send with Ctrl / Cmd + Enter; Enter inserts a newline.
shortcuts.sendEnterHelper: Send with Enter; Shift + Enter inserts a newline.
shortcuts.sectionDescription: Rebind keys for the actions below; applies instantly and is remembered.
shortcuts.capturing: Press the new key combination… (Esc to cancel)
shortcuts.sequentialDescription: Two-step chords (e.g. G then S); not rebindable yet.
shortcuts.readOnlyNote: System/raw shortcuts (e.g. Cmd+P, Cmd+,) are not rebindable here yet.

automations.pageDescription: Save a “start turn” as a reusable automation that runs headlessly, manually or on a cron schedule; each run creates a real session you can open in the workspace.
automations.sectionDescription: Only triggers while the app is running; missed schedules are not backfilled.
automations.name: Name
automations.isolationHint: v1 runs in place in the project root workspace (no isolated worktree).
automations.nameAndPromptRequired: Please fill in a name and a prompt
automations.cronRequired: A scheduled trigger needs a cron expression
